name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: To enable users to accurately record and monitor their various physical activities to maintain a comprehensive log of their exercise habits.
To provide users with clear and insightful visualizations of their fitness data and achievements, fostering motivation and understanding of their improvements over time.
To empower users to define, adjust, and track personalized fitness objectives, providing clear targets for their fitness journey.
To deliver tailored workout recommendations and plans that adapt to the user's fitness level, preferences, and goals, optimizing their training effectiveness.
To automatically and accurately collect fitness data from wearable devices, ensuring users have up-to-date and comprehensive information without manual input.
To enable users to easily share their fitness achievements and activities with their social network, promoting engagement, motivation, and community support.
lowLevelGoals: The user initiates the tracking of a new physical activity, specifying the activity type.
The user concludes the tracking of the current physical activity.
The user creates a new manual entry for a physical activity, providing details such as activity type, duration, and other relevant metrics.
The user requests to view a list of all previously recorded physical activities.
The user modifies the details (e.g., duration, distance, calories) of a specific recorded activity.
The user removes a specific recorded activity from their log.
The user requests to view a dashboard summarizing their overall fitness progress.
The user requests a detailed report for a specific period or activity type, including metrics and trends.
The user requests a graphical representation of specific performance metrics (e.g., pace, heart rate) over time.
The user requests to see a collection of earned achievement badges or milestones.
The user sets their preferences for receiving notifications about achievements and milestones.
The user receives a notification when a fitness milestone or achievement is reached.
The user defines a new fitness goal, specifying its type (e.g., weight loss, distance, duration) and target value.
The user modifies the parameters (e.g., target value, deadline) of an existing fitness goal.
The user requests to see a list of all their active and completed fitness goals.
The user manually marks a fitness goal as completed.
The user removes an existing fitness goal.
The user requests a personalized workout plan based on their current fitness level and goals.
The user modifies their preferences for workout types, intensity, or available equipment.
The user requests to view the details of a specific recommended workout session.
The user confirms the completion of a recommended workout, potentially providing feedback.
The user initiates the pairing or connection process with a wearable fitness device.
The wearable device sends a continuous stream of fitness data (e.g., heart rate, steps, GPS) to the application.
The wearable device sends a summary of a completed activity (e.g., total distance, duration, calories burned) to the application.
The user selects an activity and chooses to share its details on a social media platform.
The user selects an achievement (e.g., new personal best, goal completion) and chooses to share it on a social media platform.
The social media platform receives a request to post a user's fitness activity details.
The social media platform receives a request to post a user's fitness achievement (e.g., new personal best, goal completion).
